attributes.body_ja:
「はともかく」は副助詞（ふくじょし）「は」に副詞（ふくし）「兎（と）も角（かく）」（意味（いみ）：別（べつ）として）を組（く）み合（あ）わせた表現（ひょうげん）です。これは話（はな）し手（て）が話題（わだい）を (A) から (B) に変（か）えたいときや、(A) よりも (B) が大事（だいじ）だと言（い）いたいときに使（つか）われます。

「はともかく」は主（おも）に名詞（めいし）にそのまま付（つ）けて使（つか）われます。大抵（たいてい）、(A) よりも (B) の方（ほう）が重要（じゅうよう）なので、(A) についてはわざわざ触（ふ）れる必要（ひつよう）はないと話（はな）し手（て）が判断（はんだん）しているときに使（つか）われます。

豆知識（まめちしき）

副詞（ふくし）「兎（と）も角（かく）」は仏教（ぶっきょう）の「兎角亀毛（とかくきもう）」という表現（ひょうげん）から来（き）ていると考（かんが）えられています。これは「うさぎに角（つの）が生（は）え、亀（かめ）に毛（け）が生（は）える」ことのように、現実（げんじつ）には存在（そんざい）しないものを指（さ）す表現（ひょうげん）です。これと現代（げんだい）の「兎（と）も角（かく）」に直接（ちょくせつ）の関係（かんけい）はないとされていますが、「兎角亀毛（とかくきもう）」の「存在（そんざい）しないもの」という意味（いみ）は、「兎（と）も角（かく）」の「重要（じゅうよう）でない」というニュアンスにどこか繋（つな）がっていると言（い）えるでしょう。
attributes.body:
はともかく is an expression which makes use of the adverbial-particle は, and the adverb 兎（と）も角（かく） meaning 'to set aside', or 'at any rate'. This structure will be used when the speaker wants to change the topic from (A) to (B), or mention (B) as being something additional on top of (A).

はともかく is primarily seen following nouns in their dictionary forms. In many cases, this will be when (A) is something that the speaker thinks is not worth considering, or not worth making an issue out of when (B) is more important.

Fun-fact

The adverb 兎（と）も角（かく） is thought to have come from the Buddhist expression 兎角亀毛（とかくきもう）, meaning 'horns on rabbits, fur on turtles', referring to things that do not exist. Although this particular meaning is not widely accepted as being strongly related to the modern meaning of 兎（と）も角（かく）, some relation can be drawn between it and English phrases such as '(A) is neither here nor there' in reference to something that is non-existent, or of little importance.

attributes.description: はともかく(として) VS はさておき

attributes.body: Both set aside one item to comment on another, but the nuance differs. はおろか emphasizes that something is far beyond expectation, often meaning ‘let alone,’ and highlights an extreme gap, as in 漢字はおろか、ひらがなも読めない ('He can’t read hiragana, let alone kanji.'). はともかく means ‘setting aside’ or ‘regardless of,’ used to temporarily bracket one point and move on without judging degree, as in 値段はともかく、味は悪くない ('Putting the price aside, the taste isn’t bad.').

first_relatable.title: はおろか
first_relatable.meaning: Let alone, Much less, Needless to say, Not to mention, Not only but also

attributes.body: はともかく and を除いて both suggest setting something aside, but with different nuance. はともかく downplays relevance to the main point, as in 田中さんはともかく、鈴木さんは来ると思う (I don’t know about Tanaka, but I think Suzuki will come). を除いて explicitly excludes something, as in 田中さんを除いて全員来ると思うよ (I think everyone will come except Tanaka).

second_relatable.title: を除いて
second_relatable.meaning: Except, With the exception of, Unless

attributes.body: Both mean setting (A) aside and are often interchangeable. は別として can also mean except for (A), as in 彼を別として全員出席した (Everyone attended except him). はともかく simply sets something aside without excluding it, as in 値段はともかくデザインが好きだ (Setting aside the price, I like the design).

first_relatable.title: は別として
first_relatable.meaning: Apart from, (Setting) aside, Whether or, Except for, Save for

attributes.body: Both mean setting (A) aside and are often interchangeable. はさておき・はさておいて is often used to temporarily set something aside to prioritize another point, as in 冗談はさておき本題に入りましょう (Jokes aside, let’s get to the main point). はともかく can dismiss something as irrelevant, as in 値段はともかくデザインが気に入った (Setting the price aside, I like the design).

first_relatable.slug: はさておき-はさておいて
first_relatable.title: はさておき・はさておいて

attributes.body: はともかく carries the nuance of setting something aside to focus on the rest. For example, 田中さんはともかく、みんな来ると思う means 'Setting Tanaka aside, I think everyone will come.'. In contrast, いがい emphasizes exclusion, 田中さん以外はみんな来ると思う means 'I think everyone but Tanaka will come.' So, はともかく avoids commenting on Tanaka, while いがい explicitly excludes him.

second_relatable.title: いがい
second_relatable.meaning: Except・besides, Other than, With the exception of
